Delicious food, book in advance to avoid disappointment!
Aug 2026 • Couples
Popular and rightly so, best to book in order not to be disappointed or avoid waiting long for a table.
The food was well worth waiting for, cheerfully served by Nancy.
Excellent crab rice and beef marrow broth, the vegetarian pumpkin flower and baby squash was delicious as was the morning glory.
Do not miss the tamarind juice, a winner to wash down the delicious meal.
The ripe mango with sticky rice from dessert stand in front, a perfect finish!
